meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 帮你在电脑上安装 OneCLI 凭证管家,把 .env 文件里保存的 API 密钥搬进保险库,然后重新编译并重启服务,让机器人改用保险库里的凭证。
howto.when: 在 /update-nanoclaw 把 OneCLI 当作破坏性变更引入之后,或首次从头配置 OneCLI 时触发。

say.note: 会安装并配置 OneCLI Agent Vault

say.text: 把 .env 里的 Anthropic 密钥迁移到 OneCLI 保险库
say.note: 会自动搬移并删除 .env 里的原始密钥

say.text: 重新配置 OneCLI,重装并重新注册凭证
say.note: 会从零开始安装并登记凭证

howto.what_en: Installs the OneCLI credential manager and Agent Vault gateway, migrates existing .env API keys (Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.) into the vault, removes them from .env, then rebuilds and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Use after /update-nanoclaw introduces OneCLI as a breaking change, or any time OneCLI needs to be set up from scratch.

say_en.note: Installs and configures the Agent Vault.

say_en.text: Migrate my Anthropic keys from .env to the vault
say_en.note: Moves them and removes raw keys from .env.
